title: Fibrewise comparison of the evaluated free Cech complex
statement: Let X be a scheme and consider its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let (f_i:U_i->U_0) indexed by a set I be any family with fixed target, O a presheaf of rings, and W an object. Define O_V(W) to be the free O(W)-module on morphisms W->V as in [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Let K_n be the direct sum over tuples (i_0,...,i_n) of O_(U_i0 x_U0 ... x_U0 U_in), with the alternating projection differential, and evaluate K at W. For each phi:W->U_0 let S_phi be the disjoint union over i of {g:W->U_i | g followed by f_i=phi}. For every natural p, K(W) is exact at degree p+1 if and only if, for every phi, range(d_(p+2):O(W)[S_phi^(p+3)]->O(W)[S_phi^(p+2)]) equals ker(d_(p+1):O(W)[S_phi^(p+2)]->O(W)[S_phi^(p+1)]), where d is the alternating deletion differential of [lem-weil-pbc-power-set-complex-contractible]. This is a comparison of complexes; it does not assert that these ranges equal these kernels.

proof.text: Obtain degreewise linear equivalences with the finitely supported tuple blocks, commuting with both adjacent differentials.

Use Mathlib HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff', ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker and Function.Exact.iff_of_ladder_linearEquiv to transport exactness to range/kernel equality of the block maps.

For the forward implication embed a single block range or kernel using DFinsupp.single and project a preimage to the same coordinate. For the reverse implication rewrite with DFinsupp.range_mapRangeLinearMap and DFinsupp.ker_mapRangeLinearMap, then substitute the block equalities.

theorem freeCechComplex_exact_iff_fibres (X : Scheme.{u}) (ι : Type u) (U₀ : X.Etale)
    (U : ι → X.Etale) (f : ∀ i : ι, U i ⟶ U₀) (O : X.Etaleᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{u})
    (W : X.Etale) (p : ℕ) :
    (((PresheafOfModules.evaluation O (op W)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
      ((AlgebraicTopology.alternatingFaceMapComplex (PresheafOfModules.{u} O)).obj
        ((FormalCoproduct.mk ι fun i ↦ Over.mk (f i)).cech ⋙
          (FormalCoproduct.eval (Over U₀) (PresheafOfModules.{u} O)).obj
            (Over.forget U₀ ⋙ yoneda ⋙ PresheafOfModules.free O)))).ExactAt (p + 1) ↔
      ∀ φ : W ⟶ U₀,
        let S := Σ i : ι, {g : W ⟶ U i // g ≫ f i = φ}
        LinearMap.range (Algebra.powerSetComplexDifferential (O.obj (op W)) S (p + 1)) =
          LinearMap.ker (Algebra.powerSetComplexDifferential (O.obj (op W)) S p)
